name: Do I need to prime the ceiling before repainting after a repair?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime the ceiling before repainting after a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, priming is almost always recommended after ceiling repairs, especially when dealing with water stains, patched areas, or bare drywall. Primer creates a uniform surface for the new paint, ensuring better adhesion and preventing patched areas from
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, priming is recommended after ceiling repairs to ensure uniform paint adhesion, block stains, and prevent flashing. Use a stain-blocking primer for water damage.
